9 open-source Nikon projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Nikon cameras. 7 of 9 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: nikon-firmware-tools, furble, nd2, nsg, digital-fauxice.

  1. nikon-firmware-tools★ 307 · active · Java

    Tools from reverse engineering Nikon DSLR firmware (Nikon Hacker)

  2. furble★ 261 · active · C

    ESP32 Bluetooth remote shutter for Fujifilm, Canon, Ricoh, Nikon and Sony cameras

  3. nd2★ 82 · active · Python

    Full-featured reader for Nikon NIS-Elements .nd2 microscopy files

  4. nsg★ 64 · active · Swift

    Provide GPS data to Nikon Z cameras without SnapBridge

  5. digital-fauxice★ 46 · active · Python

    Independent RGBI dust-and-scratch repair for the Nikon LS-5000 scanner (Digital ICE replacement)

  6. darkgrade★ 35 · active · TypeScript

    TypeScript library to connect to and control Canon EOS, Sony Alpha and Nikon Z cameras

  7. nikon-flexible-color-picture-control★ 19 · active · TypeScript

    Reads and writes Nikon Flexible Color Picture Control (NP3) files

  8. nikonserial★ 12 · dormant

    Research on the serial protocol of Nikon film cameras like the F100

  9. nikon★ 7 · slowing · Python

    Python control of the Nikon Ti2-E microscope through its reverse-engineered USB protocol
